title: Why Did Jesus Weep?
question: If Jesus knew He was about to raise Lazarus, what moved Him to weep at the tomb?
blurb: The shortest verse in the Bible holds the deepest comfort: God in the flesh, weeping with those who grieve.

nodes.content: If Jesus knew He was about to raise Lazarus, what moved Him to weep at the tomb?

nodes.verseText: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come with her also weeping, He was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.
Rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.
For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin.
Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies.
